peer_review_model.notes: Independent referees are used for Matters Arising submissions that meet initial selection criteria, but details on the anonymity of the process are not provided.

preprint_policy.notes: Authors who have had a submission declined are encouraged to post it on an appropriate preprint server.

article_types.description: Formal post-publication commentary on published research papers in Nature, usually published alongside a Reply from the original authors.

total_word_limit.notes: Main text should be as concise as possible, ideally not exceeding 1200 words.

required_sections: Brief summary paragraph for non-specialist readership (used as abstract for submission purposes)

figure_limits.notes: Ideally only one or two small figures or tables; complex figures or tables may be presented as Extended Data items (ideally no more than three).

reference_limit.notes: Reference style is as for Articles.

article_types.notes: Published online but not in print; must be based on knowledge contemporaneous with the original paper, rather than subsequent scientific developments; must not contain inflammatory or intemperate language.

remarks: Does not consider Matters Arising on papers published in other journals or on Nature papers published more than 18 months ago.
